column1: # gruntz_functions.tsv - census of every retail function RVA the source
# tree labels (rva, current name, owning unit). BUILD-INTEGRITY floor: an
# RVA that vanishes from a build fails `gruntz build --full`; see
# gruntz.audit.function_census. Moves and renames are not losses - the row
# follows the label. The floor is HEAD's copy of this file unioned with
# the working tree, so deliberately removing a WRONG label means deleting
# its row here and committing the deletion.
